reviews.title: Renewal Needed?

It was a rejuvenating session.

reviews.title: This App is Absolutely Necessary
reviews.text: I have been using Jess Yoga either via the web on my computer or via the app on my phone nearly daily for over two years. Jess & what she’s created here have saved my life on multiple occasions. The yoga classes, mediations, sound healings, all of it are made with love to keep me grounded, smiling & returning to myself again & again. The quality is here in all of what she does. She’s constantly releasing new videos of her amazing creations for me To enjoy. I couldn’t be more grateful & happy to be a part of the Jess Yoga community and the cost of it has paid for itself tenfold 100 times over. It’s so worth it. Love you Jess!! 💕

reviews.title: Huge price surge post-Thanksgiving
reviews.text: I discovered Jessica’s channel on YouTube 2 years ago, and practicing almost daily to her videos has helped me recover tremendously from childbirth. I used to respect her so much as a yoga teacher and even decided to save up and treat myself to lifetime access to her app for Christmas this year because of how much her videos helped my recovery. It was $250 pre-Thanksgiving. Post-Thanksgiving, the price went up to $500 without any notice, and there’s no way I can afford that now. There is nothing at all that justifies a $500 yoga app when there are so many free yoga resources all over the internet. Now it just looks like they’re being greedy and only want the rich to be able to access wellness resources. Very disappointed and won’t be practicing to her videos anymore.

reviews.title: Best yoga app
reviews.text: I’ve been doing yoga on and off for 15 years. With Jess’s gentle voice over, creative classes and app simplicity this app embodies everything yoga should be: kind, creative, simple so it can fit in our busy lives. Jess is authentic as it feels like she wrote this app for herself. Part of me is jealous that’s this app is so good, and charges for that. But there is nothing to be jealous off: we are all better off that this app exists, I hope it gets a billion subscribers, as it is so much needed to this world of ours.

reviews.title: Medicine for My Soul
reviews.text: I love this app. Jess found me on YouTube. I’d been practicing for a bit but I wasn’t feeling the anxiety and stress relief I needed - then Jess found me. I was hesitant about getting an app because I’m an old soul in in a young body. Yet, this app has been the medicine my soul has looked for and found. Anytime I need a practice to refocus my mind, I find what I Need here. The daily quotes inspire me and have often been what I needed. I love how she is always asking us for input and keeping us challenged. Yet, through the yoga courses and challenges she creates, they help ground me and keep me focused. As someone who never thought I could heal and manage my anxiety, I have. This app has helped paired with meditation. If you are reading this and can relate to what I’ve shared, this is the perfect community for you. We’d love to have you and you’ll love it too! Namaste

reviews.title: Yoga
reviews.text:
I am from Highlands Ranch, Colorado and I am 65 years old. Recently retired and I am taking gentle yoga classes at our rec center four days a week sometimes five.

 I have never felt better in my entire life. Mind, Body and Spirit. 

  I was scrolling through YouTube and luckily stumbled upon your 25 minute evening yoga/full body stretch-sweet dreams, bedtime flow. I did it last night and absolutely loved it.

  I have to tell you that I slept so much better peaceful and restful last night than I have in a long time. 

  I am now adding you to my evening practice along with my morning ones.

  I did see on your website that you do offer other free classes, and I have to say that it is greatly appreciated that you are offering that for those of us that already paid for classes where we live.

 You have now become one of my favorite instructors. 

    Thank you so much 
Namaste
  Dana Heiland 🧘‍♀️👏💝

reviews.title: Best yoga instructor

reviews.title: Amazing app for home practice
reviews.text: I discovered Jess during the pandemic and have been practicing with her almost daily ever since. I love her flow sequencing, variety of styles and needs addressed in the sessions available on the app. Her courses are also great! My favorite thing about her though is how simple and exact her instructions are without over explaining and cluttering your mind with her thoughts and projections onto your own practice. This allows your practice to be meditational in and of itself. I have yet to find another instructor who has mastered this!

reviews.title: Grateful
reviews.text: Dear Jess, thank you for the years of practice you have engaged in. Your voice from the hours of effort has a quality I find penetrating yet soft. I believe you are sincere in your desire to help me. Keep up the great work!!

reviews.title: Jessica Richburg Yoga
reviews.text: I’ve been following Jessica since she started with YouTube videos. I really enjoy her style and flows. Her voice is also very calming. Her settings are calm. And I appreciate her because her videos have helped me pave a way to destress from everyday life, my mental health, and just finding a grounding point when things get rough. Thank you.

reviews.title: Tech support left issue unresolved
reviews.text: I renewed a yearly subscription and a few weeks later there was a bug in the app that has never been fixed. Tech support repeatedly did not follow up. I emailed over and over and tried all the fixes for five months. Because I got it from the Apple App Store, they could not issue a refund directly and gave me a few dollars back. Be aware that Apple only refunds a fraction of the remaining time on the subscription if you run into problems. Definitely would not purchase this again, and definitely not through the App Store.
